text.card: A red giant 1,268 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.87 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,635 K at its surface.
